data.change_summary: No further fixes were applied in this stage. The eighth review approved the latest remediation as-is, so the codebase remained unchanged and this pass only records that the remaining notes were non-blocking follow-ups outside the required scope of this bead.
outstanding_risks: Legacy process field names such as `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total`, `aob_k_tan_mg`, and `decomposer_k_doc_mg` still read like total-mass parameters even though runtime semantics now normalize them onto concentration- or area-based units; that rename work remains deferred to downstream normalization beads.

`TankState` convenience helpers still each recompute `self.concentrations()` when called individually in sequence, so non-hot-path callers can still pay repeated net-water-volume lookups unless they reuse `ConcentrationView` explicitly.

The startup screen net-volume preview currently derives from substrate preset enum depths rather than from a fully materialized `TankState`; if future startup flows support arbitrary per-layer substrate editing, that preview path will need to switch to state-derived values.
